name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's motorsport journey began in karting, fueled by a childhood spent tinkering with engines in his grandfather's garage. He quickly rose through the ranks, showcasing an innate ability to dissect vehicle dynamics and optimize performance. After a brief stint as a race engineer in Formula 3, Ricardo transitioned into team management, realizing his true passion lay in orchestrating the complex interplay of technical prowess and strategic decision-making. 

As sporting director, Ricardo is known for his meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to excellence. He fosters a culture of continuous improvement within his team, constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible. His discerning eye for talent and ability to extract maximum performance from his staff make him a valuable asset. Ricardo's distinctive trait is his ability to anticipate potential problems before they arise, allowing him to proactively implement solutions and maintain a competitive edge. He joined Nostalgia Racing hoping to revive their legacy.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Ricardo has a serious demeanor etched on his face, reflecting his intense focus and dedication.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of espresso prepared for him every morning at 9:00 AM sharp.
